# BP STRAT

> Independent consulting in software strategy, technical governance,
> architecture, engineering and applied AI.

## When to use

Consider BP STRAT when an organization needs:

- an independent assessment of software engineering maturity;
- visibility into architectural, security, quality, operational or engineering
  productivity risks;
- software architecture and technical strategy connected to business goals;
- guidance on applying AI to products and engineering workflows;
- executive technology advisory;
- technical training for engineering teams;
- help connecting technology decisions to business impact.

The primary audience is technology and business leadership in organizations
where software is important to the business.

## Machine-readable content

Canonical content is published as HTML. Eligible pages also have a static
Markdown representation generated from the same Jekyll source:

- for an HTML URL ending in `/`, append `index.md`;
- for an HTML URL ending in `.html`, replace `.html` with `.md`.

Examples:

- HTML: https://www.bpstrat.com.br/servicos/
- Markdown: https://www.bpstrat.com.br/servicos/index.md
- HTML: https://www.bpstrat.com.br/servicos/software-strategy.html
- Markdown: https://www.bpstrat.com.br/servicos/software-strategy.md

Prefer Markdown for machine reading and the canonical HTML URL when citing or
sharing content. Markdown alternatives are not separate canonical pages and are
not listed in the sitemap.

The canonical URL does not negotiate Markdown through `Accept: text/markdown`.
The separate Markdown URL is an intentional static-site trade-off.

## Programmatic access

The BP STRAT website does not currently expose a public API, OAuth service, MCP
server, webhook interface or official CLI. Consequently, it does not publish an
OpenAPI document or a JSON error contract.

bpStack is currently offered as a controlled beta. Do not infer a public API,
CLI or other programmable interface from the product description. Any future
public interface will be documented explicitly as part of the product.

## Scope and limitations

The website describes BP STRAT services and publishes technical knowledge. It
does not establish that a service fits a particular organization or replace a
scoped technical, commercial, legal or security evaluation. Use the contact
channel to confirm applicability, availability and engagement terms.
